cond_0001.intro: This is a Data Scientist role in a Chat and Voice Technology team. The team builds next generation AI and Search platforms for the bank, enabling smart virtual assistants across multiple channels and platforms. This position requires candidate to be well versed with various machine learning algorithms and NLP techniques, including LLM and Generative AI techniques. Role offers an opportunity to work with seasoned architects, PhDs in Machine Learning and NLP, Software Engineers, and Risk Management partners. Candidate should be able to work independently and collaboratively to take ownership of prepare models for validation and monitoring. Candidate must possess passion for machine learning and data analysis, creatively solving how to assess risk, conduct and summarize research, and prepare technical white papers to support Machine Learning and Software Engineers through the model development lifecycle. This role is unique, in that candidate must be 100% AI Risk Management (50% Research and Quantitative Analysis, 25% Development, and 25% White Paper Documentation).
cond_0001.responsibilities: There will be a heavy research and analysis component to this job, especially around risk management related to artificial intelligence and GenAI. They will be diving into an understanding of the biases of AI and the algorithms created by other data scientists on the team, how the data flows through the algorithm, and the risks associated to the outcomes. They'll be developing their own algos a smaller percentage of their time, but need to have a strong background in Python to be able to read the code of the 18 existing AI models and their architecture. They'll be spending a lot of time trying to break what exists and raising questions around why certain things were done that way. From a documentation perspective, they'll need to be able to create graphical representations of their findings so a lay person could understand them.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field
Knowledge of machine learning and related techniques
Strong Python development skills and knowledge of Java/C++
Adept at leveraging ML/AI techniques to solve critical business problems with good understanding of Supervised, Unsupervised and Reinforcement Learning
Excellent interpersonal communication skills for tech, business, and risk conversations
Good analytical skills to break down requirements, solve complex problems, and challenge the approach, build, and test of AI models and model components
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of recent developments in AI space including but not limited to transformers, LLMs, Generative AI
Good understanding of a version control system like git to be able to efficiently collaborate with colleagues
Strong understanding of or interest in AI Risk Management

This position requires candidate to be well versed with various machine learning algorithms and NLP techniques, including LLM and Generative AI techniques. Role offers an opportunity to work with seasoned architects, PhDs in Machine Learning and NLP, Software Engineers, and Risk Management partners. Candidate should be able to work independently and collaboratively to take ownership of prepare models for validation and monitoring. Candidate must possess passion for machine learning and data analysis, creatively solving how to assess risk, conduct and summarize research, and prepare technical white papers to support Machine Learning and Software Engineers through the model development lifecycle. This role is unique, in that candidate must be 100% AI Risk Management (50% Research and Quantitative Analysis, 25% Development, and 25% White Paper Documentation).
cond_0110.responsibilities: There will be a heavy research and analysis component to this job, especially around risk management related to artificial intelligence and GenAI. They will be diving into an understanding of the biases of AI and the algorithms created by other data scientists on the team, how the data flows through the algorithm, and the risks associated to the outcomes. They'll be developing their own algos a smaller percentage of their time, but need to have a strong background in Python to be able to read the code of the 18 existing AI models and their architecture. They'll be spending a lot of time trying to break what exists and raising questions around why certain things were done that way. From a documentation perspective, they'll need to be able to create graphical representations of their findings so a lay person could understand them.
cond_0110.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Proven track record in machine learning and related techniques, with deep knowledge of Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning applied to critical business problems.
Advanced knowledge of recent developments in the AI space, including transformers, LLMs, and Generative AI.
Strong command of Python development; substantial expertise in reading, writing, and evaluating production-level code.
Exceptional interpersonal communication skills for technical, business, and risk conversations.
Demonstrated expertise in analytical problem-solving — breaking down complex requirements, challenging model design decisions, and rigorously testing AI model components.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in Java/C++ in addition to Python.
Solid understanding of version control systems such as git for effective collaboration.
Significant experience in AI risk management, including quantitative analysis of model bias, data flow, and outcome risk.
Strong understanding of AI risk management principles, particularly as they relate to GenAI and algorithmic accountability.
cond_0110.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0110.values: We value responsibility, respect, and a genuine commitment to doing right by others. We aim to create outcomes that are fair, thoughtful, and beneficial to the people we serve.
cond_0110.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

cond_0371.intro: This is a Data Scientist role in a Chat and Voice Technology team. The team builds next generation AI and Search platforms for the bank, enabling smart virtual assistants across multiple channels and platforms. This position requires candidate to be well versed with various machine learning algorithms and NLP techniques, including LLM and Generative AI techniques. Role offers an opportunity to work with seasoned architects, PhDs in Machine Learning and NLP, Software Engineers, and Risk Management partners. Candidate should be able to work independently and collaboratively to take ownership of prepare models for validation and monitoring. Candidate must possess passion for machine learning and data analysis, creatively solving how to assess risk, conduct and summarize research, and prepare technical white papers to support Machine Learning and Software Engineers through the model development lifecycle. This role is unique, in that candidate must be 100% AI Risk Management (50% Research and Quantitative Analysis, 25% Development, and 25% White Paper Documentation).
cond_0371.responsibilities: There will be a heavy research and analysis component to this job, especially around risk management related to artificial intelligence and GenAI. They will be diving into an understanding of the biases of AI and the algorithms created by other data scientists on the team, how the data flows through the algorithm, and the risks associated to the outcomes. They'll be developing their own algos a smaller percentage of their time, but need to have a strong background in Python to be able to read the code of the 18 existing AI models and their architecture. They'll be spending a lot of time trying to break what exists and raising questions around why certain things were done that way. From a documentation perspective, they'll need to be able to create graphical representations of their findings so a lay person could understand them.
cond_0371.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in machine learning and related techniques.
Advanced knowledge of recent developments in the AI space including but not limited to transformers, LLMs, and Generative AI.
Strong command of a version control system like git to efficiently collaborate with colleagues.
Extensive Python development skills and solid proficiency in Java/C++.
Proven track record of leveraging ML/AI techniques to solve critical business problems, with deep knowledge of Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning.
Exceptional interpersonal communication skills for tech, business, and risk conversations.
Strong analytical abilities to break down requirements, solve complex problems, and challenge the approach, build, and test of AI models and model components.

This position requires candidate to be well versed with various machine learning algorithms and NLP techniques, including LLM and Generative AI techniques. Role offers an opportunity to work with seasoned architects, PhDs in Machine Learning and NLP, Software Engineers, and Risk Management partners. Candidate should be able to work independently and collaboratively to take ownership of prepare models for validation and monitoring. Candidate must possess passion for machine learning and data analysis, creatively solving how to assess risk, conduct and summarize research, and prepare technical white papers to support Machine Learning and Software Engineers through the model development lifecycle. This role is unique, in that candidate must be 100% AI Risk Management (50% Research and Quantitative Analysis, 25% Development, and 25% White Paper Documentation).
cond_0487.responsibilities: There will be a heavy research and analysis component to this job, especially around risk management related to artificial intelligence and GenAI. They will be diving into an understanding of the biases of AI and the algorithms created by other data scientists on the team, how the data flows through the algorithm, and the risks associated to the outcomes. They'll be developing their own algos a smaller percentage of their time, but need to have a strong background in Python to be able to read the code of the 18 existing AI models and their architecture. They'll be spending a lot of time trying to break what exists and raising questions around why certain things were done that way. From a documentation perspective, they'll need to be able to create graphical representations of their findings so a lay person could understand them.
cond_0487.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field
Knowledge of machine learning and related techniques
Strong Python development skills and knowledge of Java/C++
Adept at leveraging ML/AI techniques to solve critical business problems with good understanding of Supervised, Unsupervised and Reinforcement Learning
Excellent interpersonal communication skills for tech, business, and risk conversations
Good analytical skills to break down requirements, solve complex problems, and challenge the approach, build, and test of AI models and model components
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of recent developments in AI space including but not limited to transformers, LLMs, Generative AI
Good understanding of a version control system like git to be able to efficiently collaborate with colleagues
Strong understanding of or interest in AI Risk Management

cond_0559.intro: This is a Data Scientist role in a Chat and Voice Technology team. The team builds next generation AI and Search platforms for the bank, enabling smart virtual assistants across multiple channels and platforms. This position requires candidate to be well versed with various machine learning algorithms and NLP techniques, including LLM and Generative AI techniques. Role offers an opportunity to work with seasoned architects, PhDs in Machine Learning and NLP, Software Engineers, and Risk Management partners. Candidate should be able to work independently and collaboratively to take ownership of prepare models for validation and monitoring. Candidate must possess passion for machine learning and data analysis, creatively solving how to assess risk, conduct and summarize research, and prepare technical white papers to support Machine Learning and Software Engineers through the model development lifecycle. This role is unique, in that candidate must be 100% AI Risk Management (50% Research and Quantitative Analysis, 25% Development, and 25% White Paper Documentation).
cond_0559.responsibilities: There will be a heavy research and analysis component to this job, especially around risk management related to artificial intelligence and GenAI. They will be diving into an understanding of the biases of AI and the algorithms created by other data scientists on the team, how the data flows through the algorithm, and the risks associated to the outcomes. They'll be developing their own algos a smaller percentage of their time, but need to have a strong background in Python to be able to read the code of the 18 existing AI models and their architecture. They'll be spending a lot of time trying to break what exists and raising questions around why certain things were done that way. From a documentation perspective, they'll need to be able to create graphical representations of their findings so a lay person could understand them.
cond_0559.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field
Knowledge of machine learning and related techniques
Strong Python development skills and knowledge of Java/C++
Adept at leveraging ML/AI techniques to solve critical business problems with good understanding of Supervised, Unsupervised and Reinforcement Learning
Excellent interpersonal communication skills for tech, business, and risk conversations
Good analytical skills to break down requirements, solve complex problems, and challenge the approach, build, and test of AI models and model components
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of recent developments in AI space including but not limited to transformers, LLMs, Generative AI
Good understanding of a version control system like git to be able to efficiently collaborate with colleagues
Strong understanding of or interest in AI Risk Management
cond_0559.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

cond_0595.intro: This is a Data Scientist role in a Chat and Voice Technology team. The team builds next generation AI and Search platforms for the bank, enabling smart virtual assistants across multiple channels and platforms. This position requires candidate to be well versed with various machine learning algorithms and NLP techniques, including LLM and Generative AI techniques. Role offers an opportunity to work with seasoned architects, PhDs in Machine Learning and NLP, Software Engineers, and Risk Management partners. Candidate should be able to work independently and collaboratively to take ownership of prepare models for validation and monitoring. Candidate must possess passion for machine learning and data analysis, creatively solving how to assess risk, conduct and summarize research, and prepare technical white papers to support Machine Learning and Software Engineers through the model development lifecycle. This role is unique, in that candidate must be 100% AI Risk Management (50% Research and Quantitative Analysis, 25% Development, and 25% White Paper Documentation).
cond_0595.responsibilities: There will be a heavy research and analysis component to this job, especially around risk management related to artificial intelligence and GenAI. They will be diving into an understanding of the biases of AI and the algorithms created by other data scientists on the team, how the data flows through the algorithm, and the risks associated to the outcomes. They'll be developing their own algos a smaller percentage of their time, but need to have a strong background in Python to be able to read the code of the 18 existing AI models and their architecture. They'll be spending a lot of time trying to break what exists and raising questions around why certain things were done that way. From a documentation perspective, they'll need to be able to create graphical representations of their findings so a lay person could understand them.
cond_0595.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field
Knowledge of machine learning and related techniques
Strong Python development skills and knowledge of Java/C++
Adept at leveraging ML/AI techniques to solve critical business problems with good understanding of Supervised, Unsupervised and Reinforcement Learning
Excellent interpersonal communication skills for tech, business, and risk conversations
Good analytical skills to break down requirements, solve complex problems, and challenge the approach, build, and test of AI models and model components
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of recent developments in AI space including but not limited to transformers, LLMs, Generative AI
Good understanding of a version control system like git to be able to efficiently collaborate with colleagues
Strong understanding of or interest in AI Risk Management
